meta.prompt: Where is my package? Today is Sat 15 Nov. Show a tracking card: the item (Nikon Z fc camera body), carrier DHL Express, tracking number JD014600003SE, estimated delivery Tue 18 Nov and how many days away that is, and the shipment's five stages as a timeline with the current one marked: Label created (Nov 12), Picked up (Nov 13), In transit (Nov 14, current), Out for delivery, Delivered. Say which stage it is at ("Stage 3 of 5"). And a field where I can type delivery instructions and a Save button; once saved the card shows them back to me as saved.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Your package" "Nikon Z fc camera body" icon:"local_shipping" status:"In transit" tone:accent
  Row between
    Text.sectionTitle "Estimated delivery"
    Text.strong "Tue 18 Nov"
  Row between
    Text.muted "Carrier"
    Text.body "DHL Express"
  Row between
    Text.muted "Tracking number"
    Text.mono "JD014600003SE"
  Row between
    Text.muted "Days away"
    Text.strong "3 days"
  SectionLabel "Shipment progress" "Stage 3 of 5"
  Column gap:0
    Row gap:12
      Icon "check_circle"
      Column
        Text.body "Label created"
        Text.caption "Nov 12"
    Row gap:12
      Icon "check_circle"
      Column
        Text.body "Picked up"
        Text.caption "Nov 13"
    Row gap:12
      Icon "radio_button_checked"
      Column
        Text.strong "In transit"
        Text.caption "Nov 14, current stage"
    Row gap:12
      Icon "radio_button_unchecked"
      Column
        Text.muted "Out for delivery"
    Row gap:12
      Icon "radio_button_unchecked"
      Column
        Text.muted "Delivered"
  SectionLabel "Delivery instructions" ""
  state instructions=""
  state saved=""
  if saved==""
    InputField "Instructions" "e.g. leave at the front desk" =instructions lines:3
    ActionButton "Save" primary icon:"save" enabled:{instructions!=""} -> saved=instructions
  if saved!=""
    Callout "Saved" "{saved}" good "check_circle"
